name: list_slow_queries
description: List queries from pg_stat_statements by execution time, slowest first. For sizes, indexes, locks, cache, bloat, or replication use inspect_database.

branch_id.description: An optional ID of the branch. If not provided the default branch is used.

compute_id.description: The ID of the compute/endpoint. If not provided, the read-write compute associated with the branch will be used.

database_name.description: The name of the database. If not provided, the default neondb or first available database is used.

limit.description: Maximum number of slow queries to return

min_execution_time.description: Minimum execution time in milliseconds to consider a query as slow

project_id.description: The ID of the project to list slow queries from. Required for an unscoped connection. May be omitted when the connection is scoped to one project; if provided, it must match that project.
